United Nations Educational, Scientific and Cultural Organization (UNESCO)

title.narrative: Greening TVET to meet the skill demands of a just and green transition

description.narrative:
The project is developed to support three lines of action:
Action line 1: Support national TVET authorities and stakeholders to manage the identification of needs and co-development of a roadmap and strategies for implementation. The output will be introduced to all the relevant stakeholders to gain their support and identify their roles in the development of green skills and TVET. The processes that will be adopted in one or more countries targeted for support under the project will be implemented with relevant nuances and context-based adjustments to match the local and national conditions of coordination, partnership opportunities and skill priorities for green workforce development in the respective countries. Peer learning will be promoted, drawn from the experiences of the supported national authorities to explore opportunities for development of similar approach and support in other country contexts and TVET settings.
Action line 2: TVET teachers will be supported through piloting a Training of Trainer package designed to help address the existing gaps in technical knowledge and pedagogical competencies of TVET teachers and instructors which hamper the delivery of quality and relevant training that is also innovative and inclusive. A review of the existing conditions and practices in professional training of teachers and instructors will provide evidence of gaps and establish a clear picture of the needs and opportunities for supporting TVET teachers and sustaining the opportunities that are available to them to access training resources on their subject matter areas for self-learning and professional development and upgrading their pedagogical approach.
Action line 3: Just transition will need to address the needs of disadvantaged group of learners that are not reached by traditional training systems. The project will facilitate a close review and analysis of different policies and frameworks that are concerned with TVET, migration and the provision for skills training of refugees, internally displaced persons (IDPs), returnees, including women and girls. The data that will be collected and results of their analysis will be used to enrich the information content of selected TVET country profiles in UNESCO-UNEVOC’s database and facilitate the identification of opportunities to support the acquisition of green skills and engagement in green occupations and livelihood of the disadvantaged groups, including women and girls.
